paragraphs.text: A minimal greet tool plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
Adds a `greet` tool the agent can call with a name; the greeting text is configurable.
The bundle ships prebuilt artifacts (`lib/`) in the repository, so installation runs no build script
- `greet` tool — greets someone by name (`name: string`), returns `<greeting>, <name>!`.
Defaults live in `cordis.patch.yml` (`greeting: 'Hello'`). Override in your profile's own patch laye

Restart `dsh` after install or config changes (plugin registration happens at boot).
